units.source_text: 大约是半夜里吧，老尼僧咳嗽得厉害，醒过来了。

en.t: It must have been around midnight when the old nun began coughing violently and woke up.

units.source_text: 浮舟在灯光中看见她脸色苍白，身上却披着一件黑衣。

en.t: In the lamplight, Ukifune saw that her face was pale and that she was draped in a black robe.

units.source_text: 她发现浮舟睡在旁边，甚是诧怪，

en.t: When she noticed Ukifune sleeping beside her, she was greatly startled and puzzled,

units.source_text: 就像鼬鼠之类的动作一样，以手加额，叫道：

en.t: and with a motion like that of a weasel, she put her hand to her forehead and cried out:

units.source_text: 说时声音凄厉，眼光凝注，仿佛立刻要来吞食她的模样。

en.t: As she spoke, her voice was shrill and eerie, and her fixed stare made her look as if she would devour Ukifune at once.

units.source_text: “从前我在宇治山庄被鬼怪捉去的时候，因为失却知觉，反而毫无痛苦；

en.t: When I was carried off by a spirit at the villa in Uji before, I lost consciousness, so I felt no pain at all;

units.source_text: 如今这个鬼不知道将怎样对付我，实甚可怕！

en.t: but now I do not know what this demon will do to me, and it is truly terrifying!

units.source_text: 我由于奇怪的遭遇，死而复生，重新做了人。

en.t: Through a strange turn of fate, I died and came back to life, becoming a person once more.

units.source_text: 回想起从前种种痛苦的事，心情恼乱，

en.t: When I think back on all the painful things of the past, my heart is thrown into turmoil,

units.source_text: 且又逢可厌可怕之事，何其命苦！

en.t: and now to meet with something so hateful and frightening again, how bitter my fate is!

units.source_text: 然而我倘真个死去，也许会逢到比这更加可怕的厉鬼呢。”

en.t: Yet if I had truly died, perhaps I might have encountered a far more dreadful evil spirit than this.

units.source_text: 她躺着不能成眠，比平常更多地追思往事，便更觉此身之可悲。

en.t: She lay there unable to sleep, dwelling on the past more than usual, and felt all the more how sorrowful her own life was.

units.source_text: “我也有个父亲，但我不曾见过一面，一向在远东的常陆国度送岁月。

en.t: I too have a father, but I have never once seen him, and I have always passed my days far away in the eastern province of Hitachi.

units.source_text: 后来在京中偶然找到了一个姐姐，正在庆幸有所依靠，

en.t: Later, in the capital, I happened to find an elder sister and was just rejoicing that I had someone to rely on,

units.source_text: 却不道遭逢了意外之变，同她断绝了交往。

en.t: but then an unexpected disaster befell us, and my connection with her was cut off.
